info.title: AntCode Commando - E-Commerce Logistics API
info.description: Order lookups over the customer_neighborhood/delivery_status composite index, and the idempotent MTN MoMo / Orange Money / aggregator / GeniusPay payment webhooks.

momoSignature.name: X-Momo-Signature
momoSignature.description: Hex-encoded HMAC-SHA256 of the raw request body, keyed with the shared MOMO_WEBHOOK_SECRET. Verifies both sender authenticity and payload integrity (a tampered body invalidates the signature).

orangeSignature.name: X-Orange-Signature
orangeSignature.description: Hex-encoded HMAC-SHA256 of the raw request body, keyed with the shared ORANGE_WEBHOOK_SECRET. Verifies both sender authenticity and payload integrity (a tampered body invalidates the signature).

aggregatorSignature.name: X-Aggregator-Signature
aggregatorSignature.description: Placeholder name for whichever header the active DEFAULT_AGGREGATOR actually expects (e.g. X-Campay-Signature, X-Smobilpay-Signature) -- hex-encoded HMAC-SHA256 of the raw request body, keyed with that aggregator's own secret (e.g. CAMPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET).

geniuspaySignature.name: X-Webhook-Signature
geniuspaySignature.description: Hex-encoded HMAC-SHA256 of f"{X-Webhook-Timestamp}.{raw_request_body}", keyed with GENIUSPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET -- GeniusPay's structural validation spec binds both the timestamp and body into the signature, unlike the other providers which sign the raw body alone.

GeniusPayCallback.description: The outcome (paid vs. failed) is carried by the X-Webhook-Event header (payment.success / payment.failed), not a body field.

get.summary: List orders, optionally filtered by neighborhood and/or delivery status
get.description: Backed by idx_orders_neighborhood_status: a neighborhood-only filter uses the index's leading column, neighborhood+status uses the full composite seek.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: 1-indexed page number. Defaults to 1; clamped to 1 if lower or non-numeric.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Rows per page. Defaults to 20; clamped to 1 if lower or non-numeric.

get.summary: Fetch a single order by its internal id

post.description: Idempotent, keyed on (provider, external_transaction_id): replaying the same transaction id (e.g. after an MTN retry following a 3G timeout in Douala/Yaounde) returns already_processed instead of double-charging the order.
Idempotent, keyed on (provider, external_transaction_id): replaying the same transaction id returns already_processed instead of double-charging the order.

Idempotent, keyed on (provider, external_transaction_id), same as the other webhooks. Verified against GeniusPay's structural spec: the signature covers f"{timestamp}.{raw_body}", not the raw body alone. order_id is read from data.metadata.order_id (set by our own initiate_geniuspay_payment() call), and the payment/order status transitions to Paid only when X-Webhook-Event is payment.success.

parameters.name: X-Webhook-Timestamp
parameters.description: Unix timestamp GeniusPay signed alongside the body; part of the HMAC message.

parameters.name: X-Webhook-Event
parameters.description: Event type. payment.success marks the order Paid; anything else leaves it unpaid.

post.summary: Payment callback for the active aggregator (DEFAULT_AGGREGATOR)
post.description: Generic aggregator endpoint: routes to whichever provider DEFAULT_AGGREGATOR names (e.g. campay, smobilpay), verified with that provider's own secret and signature header from _PROVIDER_CONFIG (app/routes/webhooks.py). Same idempotency guarantee as /webhook/momo and /webhook/orange, keyed on (provider, external_transaction_id). Adding a new aggregator only means adding an entry to _PROVIDER_CONFIG -- not a new route.

401.description: Missing, invalid, or payload-mismatched signature for the active aggregator

500.description: DEFAULT_AGGREGATOR names a provider with no entry in _PROVIDER_CONFIG (misconfiguration)
